artworks.title: A fleeting thing
artworks.description: A petal catches the last of the light. For a moment, the ordinary becomes something almost otherworldly.
artworks.note: A study of fragility, held in a single stem.

artworks.title: The weight of quiet
artworks.description: Three forms, worn smooth by time. A small arrangement that holds the tension between weight and weightlessness.
artworks.note: A study of balance, and the space that holds it.

artworks.title: Where the day goes
artworks.description: The horizon softens. Water gathers the fading light, and the boundary between sea and sky begins to disappear.
artworks.note: A study of distance, at the edge of evening.

artworks.title: An empty invitation
artworks.description: An arch cut into a quiet wall. The light gathers where something might have been.
artworks.note: A study of absence, given a shape.

artworks.title: Soft geometry
artworks.description: Cloth falls over stone, its folds softening the certainty of an edge.
artworks.note: A study of the way softness changes a form.

artworks.title: After the bloom
artworks.description: The flowers have gone, leaving a delicate architecture of stems and seeds.
artworks.note: A study of what remains after a season.

artworks.title: A shape of light
artworks.description: A single folded surface becomes a landscape of ridges, valleys, and unexpected shadow.
artworks.note: A study of a small transformation.

artworks.title: The wind remembers
artworks.description: Across a dune, the wind leaves a pattern that will not last the day.
artworks.note: A study of a landscape, written and rewritten.

artworks.title: A borrowed shadow
artworks.description: A slender branch draws a second version of itself against the wall.
artworks.note: A study of an object and its quiet echo.

artworks.title: Held space
artworks.description: A pale bowl holds nothing but the changing light along its rim.
artworks.note: A study of the space inside a form.

artworks.title: The passing air
artworks.description: A sheer curtain catches a small current of air. Sunlight passes gently through it.
artworks.note: A study of movement on the edge of stillness.

artworks.title: An inward tide
artworks.description: A spiral folds slowly into itself, carrying the memory of the water.
artworks.note: A study of a form made over time.

artworks.title: Almost disappearing
artworks.description: Far ridges recede into the mist until their outlines become a suggestion.
artworks.note: A study of distance, softened by weather.

artworks.title: A darker sweetness
artworks.description: One dark pear, resting in a pool of light. Its uneven surface holds a small world.
artworks.note: A study of the familiar, looked at again.

artworks.title: The smallest disturbance
artworks.description: A circle travels outward across still water, becoming wider and less certain.
artworks.note: A study of how one moment moves through another.

artworks.title: A slow curve
artworks.description: An arc of porous stone gives a solid material an unexpected lightness.
artworks.note: A study of weight, interrupted by air.

artworks.title: A pale memory
artworks.description: A dried bloom holds the shape of summer in its papery petals.
artworks.note: A study of a moment that refuses to disappear.

artworks.title: A world within
artworks.description: Light passes through a suspended sphere, bending the room into a smaller world.
artworks.note: A study of transparency and the space it changes.

artworks.title: The other light
artworks.description: The moon hangs above the sea. A narrow path of light reaches toward the shore.
artworks.note: A study of the stillness after dusk.

artworks.title: The surface of a day
artworks.description: Sunlight grazes the creases of handmade paper, revealing the grain of an ordinary surface.
artworks.note: A study of the detail we almost miss.
